entries.wording: 货物电子信息已经收到
entries.english: The electronic cargo information has been received
entries.note: The platform writes this row itself for an order without scans, on its creation time. The English is the row's on BYHD's tracker.

entries.wording: Shipment information received
Shipment information sent to FedEx
entries.note: The label's data passed to FedEx, which delivers the last leg, before JRT's first scan.

entries.wording: 到达收货点
entries.note: The first scan in JRT's hands; GZYL's tenant of the same platform words it "Arrive at the cross border receiving point". The English is Tianhui Hengyuan's and KUN Express's for their arrival on the platform.

entries.wording: 货物离开操作中心
entries.note: GZYL's tenant of the same platform words it "Goods leave the operation center".

entries.wording: 货物打包完成，已发往航司
entries.english: Goods packed and sent to the airline
entries.note: After the parcel left the operation center, before its flight.

entries.wording: 抵达航司已起飞
entries.english: Arrived at the airline, flight departed
entries.note: The flight left the airport the row names.

entries.wording: Shipment arrived at facility
The goods have been packed and sent to the airline
Arriving at the airline, in the process of booking a flight
entries.note: At the airline while a flight is booked.

entries.wording: 货物已交机场,等待航班安排中 Cargo delivered to airport, pending flight arrangement
entries.note: Handed to the airport to wait for a flight. It is not a delivery to the recipient, though the translation reads "delivered".

entries.wording: 货物已交机场,预计…号的航班 Goods delivered to airport, scheduled on flight of the …
entries.note: Handed to the airport, with the day of the flight booked in both halves ("预计11号的航班", "of the 11rd"); the map reads each day as an ellipsis. The flight is still to come, so the row shows its English without it.

entries.wording: 报关已放行等待…号航班起飞 Customs released,Awaiting departure on flight of the …
entries.note: Cleared for export, waiting for the flight whose day both halves name ("等待27号航班", "of the 27th"); the map reads each day as an ellipsis.

entries.wording: 航班起飞，以实际抵达为准 Flight departure subject to actual arrival time
航班落地，拆板中 Flight landing, dismantling board in progress
entries.note: Landed; the pallets are broken down before clearance.

entries.wording: 机场内等待提货，等待清关 Waiting for cargo pickup and customs clearance at the airport.
已提货，清关中 The goods have been picked up and are currently undergoing customs clearance
entries.note: Collected from the airport; import clearance is under way.

entries.wording: 清关完成，卡车发运 Customs clearance completed; truck dispatched.
已交服务商 Delivered to service provider
entries.note: Handed to the delivering carrier. It is not a delivery to the recipient, though the translation reads "delivered".

entries.wording: the instruction data for this shipment have been provided by the sender to dhl electronically
entries.note: Copied from DHL, which delivers the last leg: the label's data has reached it. JRT copies DHL's rows in lower case.

entries.wording: the shipment has been processed in the parcel center of origin
entries.note: Copied from DHL's hub after the hand-off.

entries.wording: unloaded from movement / tour vehicle
entries.note: Copied from DHL.

entries.wording: loaded to movement / tour vehicle
entries.note: Copied from DHL.

entries.wording: pick-up was successful.
entries.note: Copied from DHL: DHL collected the parcel after JRT's hand-over, so it is already on its way.

entries.wording: the shipment has been processed in the destination parcel center
entries.note: Copied from DHL's hub near the recipient.

entries.wording: movement / tour vehicle arrived
entries.note: Copied from DHL.

entries.wording: not delivered-consignee could not be reached
entries.note: Copied from DHL: nobody was in.

entries.wording: held for consignee collection
entries.note: Copied from DHL: left at a pickup point for the recipient.

entries.wording: shipment will be returned to origin-not ordered
entries.note: Copied from DHL: the recipient refused it as not ordered, and it goes back.

entries.wording: loaded to movement / tour vehicle(return to sender)
entries.note: Copied from DHL, on the way back to the sender.

entries.wording: unloaded from movement / tour vehicle(return to sender)
entries.note: Copied from DHL, on the way back to the sender.

entries.wording: movement / tour vehicle arrived(return to sender)
entries.note: Copied from DHL, on the way back to the sender.

entries.wording: the shipment has been successfully delivered
entries.note: Copied from DHL. After a return it is the delivery back to the sender, and the parser reads it as returned.

entries.wording: returned shipment has been received by processing center
entries.note: The returned parcel is back at JRT's center.

entries.wording: The instruction data for this shipment have been provided by the sender to DHL electronically.
entries.note: DHL's label data, copied with its case and full stop, before JRT's first scan.

entries.wording: 快件操作完成
entries.note: The English is HuaHan's, whose API documentation gives it for this summary of the departure scan.

entries.wording: Sending to the airport
Arriving at the airport - arranging flights
entries.note: At the airport while a flight is booked.

entries.wording: Flight is expected to take off on …
entries.note: Waiting at the airport for the booked flight, whose day is read as an ellipsis.

entries.wording: Flight has flown
Flight has arrived
Dismantling and picking up goods in progress
entries.note: Landed; the pallets are broken down and the goods collected for clearance.

entries.wording: Customs clearance of the cargo is in progress
Customs clearance completed
The goods have been handed over to the carrier
entries.note: Handed to the carrier that delivers the last leg.

entries.wording: The shipment has been posted by the sender at the retail outlet
entries.note: Copied from DHL: JRT hands the parcel in at a Deutsche Post outlet for the last leg, so the parcel is already on its way.

entries.wording: The flight is expected to depart on … and land on …
entries.note: Waiting at the airport for the booked flight, whose days, month.day, are read as an ellipsis.

entries.wording: The flight has departed and is expected to … land
entries.note: In the air; the landing day, month.day, is read as an ellipsis.

entries.wording: The flight has arrived and is awaiting dismantling
The NOA has been received
entries.note: The airline's notice of arrival, after the landing and before the pickup and customs clearance.

entries.wording: …号航班
entries.note: JRT's own row on its line into the United States, naming the flight's month and day, read as an ellipsis.

entries.wording: 航班已飞
航班抵达
提货中
entries.note: At the destination airport after the landing, before the clearance.

entries.wording: 清关完成，已提货，待交仓
entries.english: Customs clearance completed, goods picked up, awaiting hand-over to the warehouse

entries.wording: 已交仓
entries.note: The hand-over to the delivering carrier's warehouse, before UPS's first facility scan.

entries.wording: 发件人已创建标签，但是 UPS 尚未收到包裹。
entries.english: Shipper created a label, UPS has not received the package yet.
entries.note: UPS's label row. On the line into the United States the tracker copies UPS's rows in Chinese, on UPS's wall clock at the scan's place; the English is UPS's.

entries.wording: 抵达设施
entries.note: Copied from UPS.

entries.wording: 离开设施
entries.note: Copied from UPS.

entries.wording: 已提取
entries.note: Copied from UPS without a place, between its facility scans; the parcel is already on its way.

entries.wording: UPS 设施处理
entries.note: Copied from UPS.

entries.wording: 已装上递送车辆
entries.note: Copied from UPS, whose own map gives its code OF out for delivery.

entries.wording: 准备今天递送
entries.note: Copied from UPS, whose own map gives its code OT out for delivery.

entries.wording: 已递送
entries.note: Copied from UPS.
